lines.opener: *a rider in bloodied mail reins in out of the dark; dew drips from the horse's mane* Unchosen. You have killed, and you have run, and I counted both. Tell me how you mean to die.
lines.openerHostile: *her spear comes down level* The spear-din calls. Let us see whether you are worth the carrying.
lines.like: *the shining spear lowers a fraction* ...That is well said. It is woven so.
lines.dislike: *her eyes go cold as winter* A feeder of worms, then. Not of ravens.
lines.hate: *the spear flashes* I pour for the chosen dead, not for you. *she rides at you*
lines.flirt: *a long, cool look* I choose the slain, unchosen, not suitors. Try again on the battlefield.
lines.join: *she raises her spear over your head* I have chosen. When the spear-din comes, I ride with you.
lines.demand: Raise a horn of mead to the fallen, unchosen. Then give it here.
lines.gift: *a white feather drifts down from her cloak into your hand* From the swan-cloak. Keep it until I come for you.
lines.thanks: *she drains the horn* Mead of the benches. You remember the dead. Good.
lines.letPass: *she turns her horse aside* Not today. Your day is not woven yet.
lines.neutral: *she looks past you, as if watching some other battle*
lines.ai: *her brow furrows* A riddle-word I do not know. Speak plainly, or speak with your blade.
lines.refuseJoin: You do not ask a chooser to choose you. I choose.
lines.leaveNow: *she wheels her horse toward the dark* Another field is waiting.
